# API Services Documentation

This directory contains auto-generated API service files synchronized with the backend API contract.

## Generated Files

All files marked with `// Auto-generated by frontend-agent` should **NOT** be edited manually. They will be overwritten on the next sync.

### Core Files

- **`api.js`** - Axios instance with authentication interceptor
- **`index.ts`** - Centralized exports for all services

### Service Modules

- **`auth.service.ts`** - Authentication (register, login, logout, refresh)
- **`automate.service.ts`** - Automation features
- **`installments.service.ts`** - Installment plans management
- **`subscriptions.service.ts`** - Recurring subscriptions
- **`transactions.service.ts`** - Financial transactions

## Usage Examples

### Authentication

```typescript
import { login, register, logout } from '@/services';

// Register
const authResponse = await register({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  name: 'John Doe',
  password: 'securePassword123'
});

// Login
const { accessToken, refreshToken, user } = await login({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  password: 'securePassword123'
});

// Store tokens
localStorage.setItem('accessToken', accessToken);
localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', refreshToken);

// Logout
await logout({ refreshToken });
localStorage.clear();
```

### Transactions

```typescript
import {
  getAllTransactions,
  createTransaction,
  getTransactionSummary
} from '@/services';

// List transactions with filters
const response = await getAllTransactions({
  startDate: '2026-01-01',
  endDate: '2026-03-31',
  type: 1, // expense
  page: 1,
  limit: 20
});

// Create transaction
const transaction = await createTransaction({
  description: 'Grocery shopping',
  amount: 150.50,
  type: 1,
  date: '2026-03-25',
  category: 2,
  notes: 'Weekly groceries'
});

// Get summary
const summary = await getTransactionSummary({
  startDate: '2026-03-01',
  endDate: '2026-03-31'
});
console.log(`Balance: ${summary.balance}`);
```

### Subscriptions

```typescript
import {
  getAllSubscriptions,
  createSubscription,
  updateSubscription
} from '@/services';

// List active subscriptions
const subscriptions = await getAllSubscriptions({ isActive: 'true' });

// Create subscription
const subscription = await createSubscription({
  description: 'Netflix Premium',
  amount: 19.99,
  billingDay: 15,
  type: 1,
  category: 5
});

// Update subscription
await updateSubscription(subscription.id, {
  amount: 22.99,
  isActive: true
});
```

### Installments

```typescript
import {
  createInstallment,
  getAllInstallments,
  cancelInstallment
} from '@/services';

// Create installment plan
const installment = await createInstallment({
  description: 'New laptop',
  totalAmount: 2400,
  totalInstallments: 12,
  startDate: '2026-04-01',
  category: 4
});

// List installments
const installments = await getAllInstallments();

// Cancel installment
await cancelInstallment(installment.id);
```

## Error Handling

All services use the centralized error handler from `@/utils/api-error`:

```typescript
import { createTransaction } from '@/services';
import { ApiError } from '@/utils/api-error';

try {
  const transaction = await createTransaction(data);
  // Success
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    switch (error.statusCode) {
      case 400:
        console.error('Validation error:', error.message);
        break;
      case 401:
        console.error('Unauthorized - redirect to login');
        break;
      case 404:
        console.error('Resource not found');
        break;
      default:
        console.error('Unexpected error:', error.message);
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment Configuration

Set the API base URL in `.env.local`:

```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3333
```

Default: `http://localhost:3333`

## Authentication

The Axios interceptor automatically adds the JWT token from `localStorage.accessToken` to all authenticated requests.

### Token Storage

After successful login:
```typescript
localStorage.setItem('accessToken', response.accessToken);
localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', response.refreshToken);
```

### Token Refresh

When access token expires:
```typescript
import { refreshToken } from '@/services';

const storedRefreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refreshToken');
const response = await refreshToken({ refreshToken: storedRefreshToken });

localStorage.setItem('accessToken', response.accessToken);
localStorage.setItem('refreshToken', response.refreshToken);
```

## Type Definitions

All TypeScript interfaces are available in `@/types/api`:

```typescript
import type {
  Transaction,
  CreateTransactionDto,
  Subscription,
  Installment
} from '@/types/api';
```

## Custom Services

If you need custom logic beyond the auto-generated services, create separate files:

```
src/services/
  ├── auth.service.ts           (auto-generated)
  ├── transactions.service.ts   (auto-generated)
  └── custom/
      └── transaction-helpers.ts (your custom code)
```

Example custom helper:

```typescript
// src/services/custom/transaction-helpers.ts
import { getAllTransactions } from '@/services';
import type { Transaction } from '@/types/api';

export async function getMonthlyExpenses(year: number, month: number): Promise<Transaction[]> {
  const startDate = `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  const endDate = new Date(year, month, 0).toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const response = await getAllTransactions({
    startDate,
    endDate,
    type: 1 // expenses
  });

  return response.data;
}
```

## Re-synchronization

When the backend API changes, re-run the sync:

```bash
# This will regenerate all auto-generated files
/sync-frontend-api
```

Check `.claude/output/sync-report.md` for breaking changes and migration notes.
